purpose: Deterministically classify each exact trace-owned URL and its relevant access context before deduplication, canonical retrieval construction, ordinary retrieval hashing, synthesis, ordinary result recording, or grading.

semantic_identity.content_definition: Complete parsed policy after removing exactly the declared semantic exclusion pointers.
semantic_identity.canonical_bytes: canonical_parser_policy_json_v1 serialization of the domain-separated envelope without a trailing newline
semantic_identity.digest: SHA-256 of the exact canonical bytes

restricted_trace_url.definition: Exact requested, final, or intermediate redirect URL captured from retrieval trace before URL-security classification.

safe_canonical_url.definition: The unchanged exact trace-owned HTTP(S) URL after public_safe classification of that URL and every relevant redirect context.

restricted_trace_reference.definition: Opaque run-local linkage generated independently of URL bytes and mapped to restricted forensic material only through controlled harness storage.

safe_retrieval_trace_projection.definition: Ordinary-disclosure provider-neutral trace structure containing safe references, roles, classifications, application-owned reason codes, and policy identity without exact restricted URLs or secret-derived URL material.

exact_url.meaning: The unchanged restricted_trace_url for the one URL position being classified.

url_role.meaning: The exact URL position in the captured retrieval trace.

retrieval_auth_context.meaning: Application-owned captured context sufficient to distinguish unauthenticated public retrieval from authenticated, session-bound, credential-bearing, signed/private, or unknown access.

redirect_context.meaning: Complete captured requested, intermediate redirect, and final URL relationship relevant to the attempted source.

origin_rule.meaning: Frozen application-owned positive public-shareability decision for the exact origin, path, query, fragment, and disclosure properties.

restricted_trace_reference.meaning: Opaque URL-independent run-local linkage to the restricted trace position.

reason_codes_representation.ordering_rule: No ordering discretion exists because a non-public result contains exactly one code.
reason_codes_representation.rationale: The frozen parser does not authorize multiple reason codes; V1 therefore returns none for accepted public_safe and exactly one deterministic safe failure reason for sensitive or indeterminate.

deterministic_url_component_interpretati.normative_authority: url_security_policy_v1 scalar grammar; runtime URL libraries are non-authoritative
deterministic_url_component_interpretati.input_domain: JSON string interpreted as an exact Unicode scalar sequence
deterministic_url_component_interpretati.ascii_case_fold: Map only U+0041 through U+005A to U+0061 through U+007A by adding 32; every other scalar is unchanged.
deterministic_url_component_interpretati.controls_whitespace_del_and_backslash_re: indeterminate unless higher-precedence sensitive evidence applies

percent_escape_interpretation.escape_grammar: A literal percent followed by exactly two ASCII hexadecimal digits 0-9 A-F or a-f encodes one octet.
percent_escape_interpretation.decode_count: Exactly one left-to-right pass; decoded output is never decoded again.
percent_escape_interpretation.octet_mapping: Octets 0x00 through 0x7F map to the same-numbered ASCII scalar. Octets 0x80 through 0xFF are non-ASCII and make the component indeterminate; UTF-8, Latin-1, locale, and runtime-library decoding are forbidden.
percent_escape_interpretation.invalid_escape: A percent not followed by exactly two ASCII hexadecimal digits makes the component indeterminate.
percent_escape_interpretation.multiple_encoding: After the one pass, a percent followed by two ASCII hexadecimal digits is a remaining escape and makes the component indeterminate.
percent_escape_interpretation.decoded_forbidden_scalars: NUL, U+0001 through U+0020, U+007F, backslash, and any non-ASCII decoded scalar make the component indeterminate.
percent_escape_interpretation.path_scope: Apply independently to every raw slash-delimited path segment.
percent_escape_interpretation.query_and_fragment_scope: Validate both the name and value of every raw field; use only the decoded name for sensitive-name matching.
percent_escape_interpretation.structural_delimiters: Only raw delimiters split components or fields. Decoded delimiters never split or reorder structure.
percent_escape_interpretation.decoded_value_delimiters: Decoded ampersand equals and semicolon remain value data and require exact raw positive-rule admission.

component_extraction.fragment: first literal # separates fragment; later # characters remain fragment data
component_extraction.query: first literal ? before fragment separates query
component_extraction.scheme: substring before first literal colon in the pre-query pre-fragment portion
component_extraction.authority: substring after required // through first literal slash, query delimiter, fragment delimiter, or end
component_extraction.path: exact substring after authority and before query or fragment
component_extraction.malformed_scheme_sensitive_scan: When the first literal colon is followed immediately by //, extract that raw authority candidate for literal-userinfo scanning even if the preceding scheme token is empty or fails the scheme grammar. No host or origin identity may be constructed until the scheme grammar and HTTP(S) value checks pass.

scheme.unsupported_missing_empty_malformed_or_s: indeterminate unless higher-precedence sensitive evidence applies

authority.userinfo_split: The last literal @ is the sole userinfo and host-port delimiter. Everything before it is raw userinfo, including any earlier literal @ characters; everything after it is the raw host[:port] suffix consumed by host and port parsing.
authority.empty_userinfo: A literal @ at authority position zero creates empty raw userinfo and remains sensitive userinfo_present.
authority.empty_host_suffix: A final literal @ creates an empty raw host[:port] suffix; userinfo_present still wins over the malformed-host indeterminate condition under global precedence.
authority.malformed_result: indeterminate unless higher-precedence sensitive evidence applies

family_decision_order: A raw host beginning with [ is exclusively a bracketed IPv6 candidate; it cannot fall through to IPv4 or DNS.
Otherwise reject empty non-ASCII percent-encoded trailing-dot colon-bearing or otherwise malformed raw hosts.
Apply the canonical dotted-decimal IPv4 predicate.
Apply the exact ASCII DNS predicate.
If no family predicate accepts the host, the result is indeterminate.

dns.grammar: ASCII labels of 1 through 63 lowercase-equivalent letters digits or hyphens; no leading or trailing hyphen; total at most 253; trailing dot forbidden
dns.numeric_overlap_exclusion: DNS evaluation occurs only after canonical IPv4 and forbidden alternate-IPv4 predicates; a host captured by either numeric predicate cannot be accepted as DNS.
dns.punycode: opaque ASCII DNS label; no IDNA decoding

ipv4.grammar: exactly four decimal components 0 through 255; no leading zero except the single digit 0
ipv4.forbidden_alternate_predicate: After canonical IPv4 fails, classify as forbidden alternate IPv4 when the entire raw host is ASCII decimal digits, when it is 0x or 0X followed by one or more ASCII hexadecimal digits, or when every literal-dot-separated component is either one or more ASCII decimal digits or 0x or 0X followed by one or more ASCII hexadecimal digits. A host matching this predicate is indeterminate and cannot fall through to DNS.

ipv6.grammar: bracketed hexadecimal only; one optional ::; expand to exactly eight 16-bit groups; embedded IPv4 and zone identifiers forbidden
ipv6.identity: lowercase RFC 5952 form with no group leading zeros and earliest longest zero run of length at least two compressed

port.grammar: ASCII unsigned base-10 digits; 0 through 65535; no leading zero when length exceeds one
port.zero_and_nondefault: valid but require exact positive origin rule
port.empty_nonnumeric_signed_negative_out_of_: indeterminate unless higher-precedence sensitive evidence applies

path.segments: split literal slash only; preserve empty repeated trailing and dot segments
path.sensitive_scan: split raw slash then percent-decode each segment exactly once and ASCII-case-fold A-Z
path.sensitive_sequence_anchoring: Match a recognized sensitive path pattern at any contiguous position in the complete once-decoded ASCII-case-folded segment array. Root anchoring is not required, suffix segments are allowed, and empty segments are never skipped.
path.grant_definition: one non-empty decoded segment containing no slash percent escape dot or dot-dot
path.dot_rule: A decoded segment exactly equal to . or .. is indeterminate. A dot within another ordinary segment is not syntax-invalid, but a recognized grant segment containing any dot is not a grant.
path.encoded_slash_invalid_escape_non_ascii_o: indeterminate unless higher-precedence sensitive evidence applies

query.positive_matching: presence plus exact raw query allowlist
query.sensitive_name_comparison: ASCII case-insensitive after zero and exactly one percent decode
query.name_encoding: Apply the frozen percent-escape interpretation to each raw name. A decoded ampersand equals or semicolon in a name is indeterminate.
query.value_encoding: Apply the frozen percent-escape interpretation to each raw value. Decoded delimiters remain value data and do not create fields.
query.empty_name_and_value: Both are syntactically representable and remain in exact raw positive matching; neither supplies public proof by itself.

fragment.grammar: same field grammar as query for every present fragment, including one field without equals
fragment.positive_matching: presence plus exact raw fragment allowlist
fragment.sensitive_name_comparison: ASCII case-insensitive after zero and exactly one percent decode
fragment.name_and_value_encoding: Apply the exact query name/value encoding rules to every fragment field; an ordinary fragment without equals is one field whose entire raw text is the name and whose value is absent.

empty_and_absent.port: absent valid under default-port rule; trailing colon malformed
empty_and_absent.userinfo: no marker and empty marker distinct; empty marker is sensitive

deterministic_url_component_interpretati.malformed_precedence: Run frozen raw-component sensitive scanners and authentication evaluation before final malformed disposition; select one reason under the global precedence table.

input_type_validation.exact_url: required non-empty JSON string; invalid type or empty string is indeterminate
input_type_validation.url_role: required exact member of the frozen url_role vocabulary; otherwise indeterminate
input_type_validation.retrieval_auth_context: required exact member of the frozen retrieval_auth_context vocabulary; unknown is the explicit indeterminate member; other values are indeterminate
input_type_validation.redirect_context: required JSON object with the redirect_policy exact shape; otherwise indeterminate
input_type_validation.origin_rule: required JSON object with one frozen origin-rule shape; otherwise indeterminate
input_type_validation.restricted_trace_reference: required non-empty JSON string; contents are opaque and echoed exactly; the classifier applies no pattern, decoding, or semantic inference to it

userinfo.condition: one or more literal @ markers in authority, including an empty marker

origin_identity_object.scheme: exact lowercase http or https produced by the scalar parser
origin_identity_object.host: non-empty exact canonical DNS IPv4 or IPv6 string produced by the scalar parser
origin_identity_object.effective_port: JSON integer 0 through 65535; booleans and non-integral numbers are invalid

nonmatched_rule_exact_shape.result: indeterminate unless a higher-precedence sensitive reason applies

path_match.values: JSON array of exact raw path strings; order and duplicates do not change membership

query_match.values: JSON array of objects with exactly present and raw; present is boolean and raw is a JSON string

fragment_match.values: JSON array of objects with exactly present and raw; present is boolean and raw is a JSON string

matched_rule_scalar_types.rule_hash: required exactly 64 lowercase hexadecimal JSON string

envelope_values.content: the complete matched-rule object after removing exactly rule_hash

rule_hash.canonical_bytes: canonical_parser_policy_json_v1 serialization of the exact envelope without a trailing newline
rule_hash.digest: SHA-256 of the exact canonical bytes encoded as exactly 64 lowercase hexadecimal characters

matching_algorithm: require exact origin identity tuple equality
require exact raw path allowlist membership
require exact query presence and raw value allowlist membership
require exact fragment presence and raw value allowlist membership

conditions: valid absolute ASCII HTTP(S) scalar parse
exact path query and fragment allowlist membership
exact URL disclosure grants no access
no unresolved syntax encoding host port origin or redirect condition

indeterminate_rule.definition: No higher-precedence sensitive reason applies and complete positive public-shareability proof fails.

inclusion_semantics.userinfo_present: any literal userinfo marker in current authority
inclusion_semantics.signed_url_detected: recognized signed material in current exact URL
inclusion_semantics.authenticated_context: current retrieval authentication context is authenticated session-bound credential-bearing or signed-private
inclusion_semantics.sensitive_redirect_context: multi-URL redirect context contains any directly sensitive member
inclusion_semantics.recognized_sensitive_query_material: recognized sensitive query fragment or path material in current exact URL
inclusion_semantics.public_shareability_indeterminate: any unresolved syntax encoding authentication origin-rule or redirect condition

classification_and_reason_precedence.selection_rule: Collect every applicable condition, sort by the declared priority, and return only the first reason. If none apply and complete positive proof passes, return public_safe with an empty array.

redirect_policy.position_types: current_position requested_position final_position and every member.position are JSON integers greater than or equal to zero; booleans and non-integral numbers are invalid
redirect_policy.position_order: members array order is authoritative and member.position must equal its zero-based array index; positions must therefore be contiguous and unique
redirect_policy.no_redirect_shape: exactly one final_url member; requested_position final_position and current_position are zero
redirect_policy.complete_redirect_shape: two or more contiguous members; first requested_url; zero or more intermediate_redirect_url; last final_url; requested_position zero; final_position last
redirect_policy.outer_input_binding: all five outer member fields must exactly equal members[current_position]; outer redirect_context is the sixth input
redirect_policy.outer_input_equality: Exact parsed-JSON equality under canonical_parser_policy_json_v1; no coercion case folding normalization or reference-pattern interpretation is allowed.
redirect_policy.maximum_member_count: governed only by separately frozen parser resource limits; no new threshold
redirect_policy.member_classification: classify every member under the same direct scalar and origin rules
redirect_policy.multi_url_sensitive_condition: For capture_status complete only, any directly sensitive member, including the current member, contributes sensitive_redirect_context to every member classification; the global reason table then selects one reason. no_redirect never contributes sensitive_redirect_context because it is not multi-URL.
redirect_policy.all_public_complete_result: public_safe for each member; only exact final member may become safe_canonical_url
redirect_policy.loop_detection: canonical_parser_policy_json_v1 equality of loop identity; any repeated identity is a loop

mandatory_raw_provider_response_hash.rule: Compute the frozen P1 #2 SHA-256 over the canonical raw response byte surface when that surface exists, even when restricted raw bytes contain URL material.

steps: extract exact raw components with the frozen scalar delimiter algorithm
collect direct sensitive reasons from userinfo signed names sensitive names and path grammar
validate scalar syntax host port and component encoding
construct canonical origin and loop identities
recompute and match the exact origin rule
validate context shape and detect loops
select exactly one reason under global precedence or return public_safe
emit exactly seven classifier output fields
map invalid classification to failed_url_security_validation before deduplication

schema.topology_preflight_non_invocation_except: all six named slots present with explicit null availability; classifier is not invoked

two_implementation_invariant.requirement: Independent Python and JavaScript scalar implementations using no high-level URL parser must produce identical results for all 143 vectors.

provider_neutrality.future_adapter_role: Translate provider-native restricted trace data into the common deterministic inputs without adjudicating safety.

final_invariants: Classification is exactly public_safe, sensitive, or indeterminate.
Classifier output uses reason_codes and no alias.
Reason codes are drawn only from the frozen six-value vocabulary.
Every invalid classifier result contains exactly one reason code selected by the global precedence table.
Public_safe requires positive deterministic proof and never follows from a denylist miss.
Runtime URL libraries cannot define parsing or origin semantics.
Every relevant exact redirect URL is independently classified before chain aggregation.
Sensitive or indeterminate fails the entire attempt before deduplication or synthesis.
Only an unchanged exact public_safe final trace URL may become safe_canonical_url.
Restricted URL material never enters ordinary hashes results grading synthesis Git or safe errors.
Provider and model claims never adjudicate URL safety.
Execution remains blocked until all authoritative experiment prerequisites pass and explicit authorization is recorded.
